book.guhs.einde2_zij.de_eerste.0: Before Aang Guh there was Roku Guh. Before Roku Guh there was Kyoshi Guh. And before that many more. But who was the very first Guhvatar?
book.guhs.einde2_zij.de_eerste.1: Nobody knows for sure. Some say it was a guh in a hood who lived far away, beyond the mist.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.de_eerste.2: Others say the first Guhvatar was an ordinary guh who one day did what nobody else dared: listen to all four elements at once.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.de_eerste.3: The library keeps this book on the bottom shelf. Wan Shi Guh says some questions are better left lying for a while.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.grote_zingende.0: Sailors of the void tell of something enormous that floats between the islands and sings. Most people laugh about it.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.grote_zingende.1: An old captain in the Void Harbor does not laugh. He says you only see it if you believe in it.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.grote_zingende.2: This book makes no claim. It only notes that sometimes a song sounds in the void that nobody can explain.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.knabbelkoor.0: In the Nibble Chorus Forest grow purple plants that sing softly. They don't sing words, only one long, low tone. A bit like a very content guh.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.knabbelkoor.1: The old stories say they sing because otherwise they would fall asleep. Science says they sing because the wind blows through their hollow stems.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.knabbelkoor.2: Whoever eats a fruit flashes away a little. Sometimes a cheese mite jumps out. That has nothing to do with singing, but it is in this book too.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.luchtbizons.0: The sky bison guh has six legs, a flat tail and the sweet ears of a guh. It flies without wings. Nobody knows how. Neither does it.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.luchtbizons.1: A sky bison guh eats hay, apples and, when nobody is looking, nibbles. It never loses its way home, unless the wind stops whistling.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.luchtbizons.2: To call a sky bison guh, whistle. If you can't whistle, say 'yip yip' very loudly. That works too.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.luchtbizons.titel: The Sky Bison Guh: a Field Guide
book.guhs.einde2_zij.vier_volkeren.0: Long ago four peoples lived in the Guh End. They shared the wind, the water, the earth and the fire. And the nibbles. Especially the nibbles.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.vier_volkeren.1: The air nomad guhs lived in temples that floated. They ate little, laughed a lot and left every door open for whoever came by.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.vier_volkeren.2: The water tribe guhs lived in the ice and the blue cheese. They could talk to water. The water did not talk back, but it did listen.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.vier_volkeren.3: The earth guhs built cities with walls, and the fire guhs built forges. Both thought the other built too loudly. Then came a Guhvatar.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.zon_ging_vadsen.0: Professor Zei Guh noted: sometimes the moon slides in front of the sun. Then, in the middle of the day, it goes dark for a while.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.zon_ging_vadsen.1: Whoever firebends on such a day notices that the fire lies down for a while too. As if it takes a nap. This is no secret. It is simply astronomy.
book.guhs.einde2_zij.zon_ging_vadsen.2: A note in the margin, in another hand: 'Whoever reads this: make sure you don't have anything important to do that day, nyeg.'
book.guhs.einde2_zij.zon_ging_vadsen.tit: The Day the Sun Went for a Chonk
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_bibliothe: Talk to Wan Shi Guh in the owl hall, at the very bottom of the library. You get in through the window in the spire and then keep going down.
Bring Wan Shi Guh three pieces of knowledge: a map, a compass, a clock, a spyglass or a book. Hold it and click him.
A fox guh brings the book that suits you. Find one and click it.
Turn the wheel of the planetarium, next to Professor Zei Guh: the side hall on the west side, at the height of hall 1.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_handel.de: On the market of the Void Harbor, Ender Mikas stand behind their stalls. Their offers change every day. Click one to trade.
Every element you learn in the story of the Guhvatar leaves something lasting: an &6air leap&r (in mid-air too), &6walking on water&r, a &6rock pillar&r that throws monsters into the air (sneak: a &6rock wall&r) and a &6fire bolt&r that gives monsters a tap. They never hit guhs. One key (by default &dH&r): tap = use, hold = the element wheel.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_kyoshi_do: Talk to the leader of the Kyoshi Warrior Guhs in the dojo, before the wall of fans.
Stand on the golden tile in the middle of the dance floor and follow the calls on the beat: DUCK (shift), JUMP or TURN (look sideways). Ten right is enough.
Go to the makeup table under the mirror in the southwest corner of the dojo (click it, or crouch in front of it).
Show yourself to the foaming fan guh by the gate: click him.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_leeuwschi: Walk over the shell of the island to the stone ring at the very top.
Go down along his flank, to the front below his head, and stand on the palm of his raised paw.
Hold a cheese nibble and click his snout while you stand on his palm.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_mika_kok_: Talk to the Mika cook in the kitchen of a Mika Fortress.
Bring the cook 2 blue cheese mushrooms, 2 crystal cheese nuggets, 2 nibble chorus fruits and 1 crumb cloud from the outer islands.
Talk to the fortress captain behind his desk on the ground floor and come up with something that works.
Back to the cook in the kitchen.
Visit the cook in his new kitchen in the Void Harbor: The Sorry Spatula, on the quay.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_omashguh_: Talk to King Bumi Guh in the throne room at the top of the palace of Omashguh.
Get the key out of the waterfall of glass (trial 1, on the west side below the throne room). Climbing won't work: use your earth power in the room.
Find Flopsie, the king's pet. The hutch of trial 2 (on the east side below the throne room) is awfully small...
Go to the arena of trial 3 (in the middle below the throne room), choose your opponent and answer the king's last question.
Jump into a mail chute on the loading platform in front of the palace and slide to the post office in under 40 seconds.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_ringenrac: Talk to the race master guh on the starting platform, fly through all eighteen rings and land on the landing strip. Under 45 seconds and you become a &dRing Racer&r.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_veer.desc: The ferry guh in the Void Harbor sails you for free to every place in the Guh End you know, and to the main island.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_vestingbe: Free six skinny guhs from the cells of the Mika Fortresses (give them a nibble). That earns the title &dFortress Liberator&r.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_vetbootje: Read the note on the harbor board at the pier of a Mika Fortress (click it).
Bring the shipwright guh at the shipyard on the west side of the Void Harbor 24 planks, 8 wool, 4 Mika's Grease and 2 flash crumbs. Then he builds your boat.
Your little grease boat is ready. Talk to the shipwright guh and give it a color, a sail and a name.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_vuurtempe: Talk to Shyu, the friendly Fire Sage by the hatch behind the altar, on the ground floor of the tower.
At the top of the tower, stand before each fire door and use your fire power: light all five locks.
The doors are open, just for you. Walk straight at a fire door: you step through it, into the sanctum.
Talk to the spirit of Guhvatar Roku Guh in the sanctum.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_zij_westelijk: Talk to the air nun guh by the stairs in the hanging hall: the temple hangs upside down below the island.
Stand on the balcony at the end of each of the five wind corridors and use your air power there. Four corridors run from the hall to the four sides, the fifth is the organ pipe at the bottom.
Five sky bison guhs drift lost around the island. Fly to them (on Appa or with your wings) and click them, or aim your Air Ball at them from a distance: they fly to their own pen.
The herd is home and the temple sings. Tell the air nun guh.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.section.einde2_zij_hav: The Void Harbor and the Mika Fortress
gui.guhs.einde2_kracht.zij_aardzuil.uitl: A rock pillar bursts up where you look (up to 12 blocks) and throws monsters into the air. Look at your feet: it lifts you. Sneak: a rock wall right in front of you. It all crumbles away after a few seconds.
gui.guhs.einde2_kracht.zij_handvlam.uitl: Shoot a fire bolt 10 blocks ahead. A monster gets a tap and catches fire for a moment. It lights campfires and candles; nothing else catches fire, and it never hits guhs.
gui.guhs.einde2_kracht.zij_luchtsprong.u: Leap high on the wind, and once more in mid-air. You always land softly.
gui.guhs.einde2_kracht.zij_waterloop.uit: Walk on water for fifteen seconds. Sneak to sink. You land softly too.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.beloning.vetbootje: A little grease boat of your own
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.boek.door: From the library of Wan Shi Guh
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bieb.0: Wan Shi Guh sits %s, at the very bottom of the library, in the owl hall. You get in through the window in the spire and then keep going down.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bieb.1: Wan Shi Guh sits %s, in the owl hall. Hold a map, compass, clock, spyglass or book in your hand and click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bieb.2: A fox guh with a book stands %s, next to the owl's platform. Click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bieb.3: The planetarium lies %s: the side hall on the west side, at the height of hall 1. Click the lodestone of the wheel, next to Professor Zei Guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.bootje.1: The shipwright guh stands %s, at the shipyard on the west side of the Void Harbor, by the slipway.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kok.0: The Mika cook stands %s, by his soup pot in the kitchen of the Mika Fortress.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kok.2: The fortress captain sits %s, behind his desk on the ground floor of the fortress. Talk to him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kok.4: The Sorry Spatula, the cook's new little kitchen, lies %s, on the quay of the Void Harbor.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kyoshi.0: The leader of the Kyoshi Warrior Guhs stands %s, in the dojo on the east side of the village, before the wall of fans.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kyoshi.1: The golden tile lies %s, in the middle of the dance floor in the dojo. Stand on it and the dance starts by itself. Do what shows up big on screen: DUCK (shift), JUMP or TURN (look sideways). Ten of the sixteen right is enough.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kyoshi.2: The makeup table stands %s, under the mirror in the southwest corner of the dojo. Click it.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.kyoshi.3: The foaming fan guh stands %s, next to his fan club stall by the gate, close to the landing place. Click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.lucht.0: The air nun guh stands %s, by the stairs in the hanging hall: the temple hangs upside down below the island.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.lucht.1: The balcony of a silent wind corridor lies %s (the column of light points it out). Stand on the balcony and use your air power there. Four corridors run from the hall to the four sides, the fifth is the organ pipe at the bottom.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.lucht.2: A stray sky bison guh drifts %s (the column of light points it out). Fly there and click it, or aim your Air Ball at it from a distance: then it flies to its pen.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.lucht.3: The herd is home. The air nun guh is waiting %s, by the stairs in the hanging hall.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.0: King Bumi Guh sits %s, on his throne in the throne room at the top of the palace of Omashguh.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.1: Trial 1 begins %s: the room with the waterfall of glass, on the west side below the throne room. Go in and use your earth power there (your power key, H by default).
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.2: Trial 2 begins %s, on the east side below the throne room: Flopsie's hutch. Take a good look at how big those paw prints are...
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.3: The arena of trial 3 lies %s, in the middle below the throne room. Walk in and choose your opponent.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.omash.4: The loading platform of the mail chutes lies %s, in front of the palace. Step into a mail chute: the clock runs from the first bit of chute. Too late? Then the mail lift takes you back up.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.schildpad.0: The highest point of his shell lies %s: walk through the forest on his back to the stone ring.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.schildpad.1: His raised paw lies %s, at the front below his head. Walk down along his flank and stand on the middle pad of his palm.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.schildpad.2: His snout is %s. Hold a cheese nibble in your hand and click it while you stand on his palm.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.vuur.0: Shyu stands %s, by the hatch behind the altar on the ground floor of the tower.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.vuur.1: The five fire doors stand %s, in a row at the top of the tower. Stand right in front of a door and use your fire power: the lock starts to burn. The column of light points out the next door.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.vuur.2: The fire doors are open, just for you (%s). Walk straight at a door: you step through it, into the sanctum.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.hint.vuur.3: The spirit of Roku Guh stands %s, before his statue in the sanctum. Click him.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.kracht.aarde_hier: There is no room for a rock wall here.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.kracht.aarde_mis: No ground in reach: look at the ground where the rock pillar should come up.
gui.guhs.einde2_zij.kracht.geen: You don't know any chonk art here yet.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.ringenracer: Fly the Guh Wing Ring Race in under 45 seconds.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vestingbevrijder: Free six skinny guhs from the cells of the Mika Fortresses.
gui.guhs.verhalen.bibliotheek_wan_shi_gu: Talk to Wan Shi Guh in the owl hall, at the very bottom of the library. You get in through the window in the spire and then keep going down.
Bring Wan Shi Guh three pieces of knowledge: a map, a compass, a clock, a spyglass or a book. Hold it and click him.
A fox guh brings the book that suits you. Find one and click it.
Turn the wheel of the planetarium, next to Professor Zei Guh: the side hall on the west side, at the height of hall 1.
Every day Wan Shi Guh trades a piece of knowledge for a book.
Half buried in the rind sand lies the library of Wan Shi Guh, the owl who knows everything. Whoever learns something there brings something too.
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.nu.0: Talk to the leader of the Kyoshi Warrior Guhs in the dojo, before the wall of fans.
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.nu.0_eleme: The leader is waiting for someone who can waterbend. You learn that in the story of the Guhvatar.
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.nu.1: Stand on the golden tile in the middle of the dance floor and follow the calls on the beat: DUCK (shift), JUMP or TURN (look sideways). Ten right is enough.
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.nu.2: Go to the makeup table under the mirror in the southwest corner of the dojo (click it, or crouch in front of it).
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.nu.3: Show yourself to the foaming fan guh by the gate: click him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.nu.klaar: The fan is still out cold. Your guh looks splendid in Kyoshi makeup.
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.uitleg: In Kyoshi Village the Kyoshi Warrior Guhs train with fans beneath the giant statue of Guhvatar Kyoshi Guh. And at the gate stands her biggest fan.
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.waar.0: Kyoshi Village, the dojo on the east side
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.waar.1: Kyoshi Village, the dance floor in the dojo
gui.guhs.verhalen.kyoshi_dorp.waar.3: Kyoshi Village, the gate by the landing place
gui.guhs.verhalen.leeuwschildpad.naam: The Blessing of the Lion Turtle
gui.guhs.verhalen.leeuwschildpad.nu.0: Walk over the shell of the island to the stone ring at the very top.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leeuwschildpad.nu.1: Go down along his flank, to the front below his head, and stand on the palm of his raised paw.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leeuwschildpad.nu.2: Hold a cheese nibble and click his snout while you stand on his palm.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leeuwschildpad.nu.klaa: You carry the scale of the Lion Turtle. If you fall into the void, he catches you.
gui.guhs.verhalen.leeuwschildpad.uitleg: The island is no island: it is the old Lion Turtle Guh, swimming through the void for ages. He gives one blessing per guh. Or per player.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_kok.nu.0: Talk to the Mika cook in the kitchen of a Mika Fortress.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_kok.nu.1: Bring the cook 2 blue cheese mushrooms, 2 crystal cheese nuggets, 2 nibble chorus fruits and 1 crumb cloud from the outer islands.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_kok.nu.2: Talk to the fortress captain behind his desk on the ground floor and come up with something that works.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_kok.nu.3: Back to the cook in the kitchen.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_kok.nu.4: Visit the cook in his new kitchen in the Void Harbor: The Sorry Spatula, on the quay.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_kok.nu.klaar: The cook has a kitchen of his own and you have the recipe for Sorry Soup.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_kok.uitleg: In the kitchen of every Mika Fortress stands a cook with a floppy hat. He secretly cooks for the captured guhs, and he is sorry about everything.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mika_kok.waar.2: A Mika Fortress, the ground floor
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.nu.0: Talk to King Bumi Guh in the throne room at the top of the palace of Omashguh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.nu.0_element: King Bumi Guh is waiting for someone who can earthbend. You learn that in the story of the Guhvatar.
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.nu.1: Get the key out of the waterfall of glass (trial 1, on the west side below the throne room). Climbing won't work: use your earth power in the room.
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.nu.2: Find Flopsie, the king's pet. The hutch of trial 2 (on the east side below the throne room) is awfully small...
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.nu.3: Go to the arena of trial 3 (in the middle below the throne room), choose your opponent and answer the king's last question.
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.nu.4: Jump into a mail chute on the loading platform in front of the palace and slide to the post office in under 40 seconds.
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.nu.klaar: Bumi Guh is still laughing. Give your Crystal Candy Ring a lick.
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.uitleg: King Bumi Guh of Omashguh is more than a hundred years old and still wonderfully mad. His trials work differently than you think.
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.waar.1: Omashguh, trial 1 (west, below the throne room)
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.waar.2: Omashguh, trial 2 (east, below the throne room)
gui.guhs.verhalen.omashguh.waar.3: Omashguh, trial 3 (middle, below the throne room)
gui.guhs.verhalen.vetbootje.naam: A Little Grease Boat of Your Own
gui.guhs.verhalen.vetbootje.nu.0: Read the note on the harbor board at the pier of a Mika Fortress (click it).
gui.guhs.verhalen.vetbootje.nu.1: Bring the shipwright guh at the shipyard on the west side of the Void Harbor 24 planks, 8 wool, 4 Mika's Grease and 2 flash crumbs. Then he builds your boat.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vetbootje.nu.2: Your little grease boat is ready. Talk to the shipwright guh and give it a color, a sail and a name.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vetbootje.nu.klaar: You have a little grease boat of your own. The grease whistle always calls it back.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vetbootje.uitleg: A harbor board hangs at the pier of every Mika Fortress. There is a note on it for anyone who wants a ship of their own.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.nu.0: Talk to Shyu, the friendly Fire Sage by the hatch behind the altar, on the ground floor of the tower.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.nu.0_e: Shyu the Fire Sage is waiting for someone who can firebend. You learn that in the story of the Guhvatar.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.nu.1: At the top of the tower, stand before each fire door and use your fire power: light all five locks.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.nu.2: The doors are open, just for you. Walk straight at a fire door: you step through it, into the sanctum.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.nu.3: Talk to the spirit of Guhvatar Roku Guh in the sanctum.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.nu.kla: Roku Guh told you his story. The eternal little flame is yours.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.uitleg: On a crescent island stands the temple of Guhvatar Roku Guh. Behind five fire doors his statue waits, and maybe more than that.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.waar.0: Fire Temple of Roku Guh, the ground floor
gui.guhs.verhalen.vuurtempel_roku.waar.2: Fire Temple, behind the fire doors at the top of the tower
gui.guhs.verhalen.westelijke_luchttempel: Talk to the air nun guh by the stairs in the hanging hall: the temple hangs upside down below the island.
The air nun guh is waiting for someone who can airbend. You learn that in the story of the Guhvatar.
Stand on the balcony at the end of each of the five wind corridors and use your air power there. Four corridors run from the hall to the four sides, the fifth is the organ pipe at the bottom.
Five sky bison guhs drift lost around the island. Fly to them (on Appa or with your wings) and click them, or aim your Air Ball at them from a distance: they fly to their own pen.
The herd is home and the temple sings. Tell the air nun guh.
The temple sings again and the herd is home.
The Western Air Temple hangs upside down beneath an island. The wind used to whistle through its corridors and a herd of sky bison guhs lived there. Now it is silent.
Western Air Temple, the hanging hall
Western Air Temple, the wind corridors
item.guhs.einde2_zij_kristalsnoep_ring.l: *lick* Crystal candy! You dig extra fast.
From King Bumi Guh. Give it a lick: you dig extra fast for a while.
item.guhs.einde2_zij_spijtsoep.lore: From the sorry Mika cook. Sorry it's so tasty.
item.guhs.einde2_zij_zegenschub.lore: If you fall into the void of the Guh End, the old turtle catches you.
key.guhs.einde2_kracht: Chonk Art (tap: use, hold: element wheel)
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.hint.kennis: Give Wan Shi Guh three pieces of knowledge (map, compass, clock, spyglass, book): hold it and click him.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.hint.planetar: Turn the wheel of the planetarium, next to Professor Zei Guh.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.hint.vos: Find a fox guh in the library and click it.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.kennis_een.0: Hm. A good start. %s to go.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.kennis_een.2: Ah, I didn't have this yet. %s to go.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.kennis_klaar: Three pieces of knowledge. A fair trade. My fox guhs are now looking for the book that suits you. Find one.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.kennis_wat: Knowledge is a map, a compass, a clock, a spyglass, a book. %s pieces to go. Hold it and give it to me.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.klaar: You learned something and brought something. Come back whenever you like: every day I trade a piece of knowledge for a book.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.later.0: Bring me knowledge, and I give you a book. One a day. I'm an owl, not a printing press.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.later.1: My fox guhs are quick, but sometimes they put books on the wrong shelf. I suspect they do it on purpose.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.later.2: Everything in here is true. Except the cookbooks.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.planetarium: In the planetarium Professor Zei Guh turns the sky. Go and have a look. What you see there matters.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.planetarium_k: Look! The moon slides in front of the sun. In the middle of the day it goes dark for a while. Even fire lies down then.
The day the sun went for a chonk. Write it down, Guhvatar. One day it may matter.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.prof_later.0: I live here now. I still have four thousand books to go. Roughly.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.prof_later.1: Do you know how to get out of a library half buried in sand? Neither do I. But I don't mind.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.prof_wiel: Ah, a visitor! Give the wheel a turn. See what the sun and the moon do.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.regels.1: Welcome to my library. I am Wan Shi Guh, he-who-knows-ten-thousand-things. About ten thousand. I'm still counting.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.regels.2: There are three rules. No Mikas. No fire. And whoever takes knowledge here, brings knowledge too.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.regels.3: What do you know, little Guhvatar? Bring me three pieces of knowledge, and my fox guhs will find a book for you.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.ruil: A fair trade. Read it well. And put it back neatly in your own bookcase later.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.ruil_morgen: You already traded today. Come back tomorrow.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.vos: *Sniffs your ears, lays a book in your paws and runs off.*
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bieb.vos_zoek: A fox guh brings your book. They run around everywhere in the halls.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.af: Your little grease boat is done!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.af_sub: Go back to the shipwright guh
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.af_zeg: Done! The finest little boat I ever built. Come and christen it.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.begint: Everything's here! Watch the slip. Just a moment: hammer hammer, saw saw, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.briefje.2: Want a little grease boat of your own? Small, slow, flies anyway. With a chest and seats for your guhs.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.briefje.3: Bring 24 planks, 8 wool, 4 Mika's Grease and 2 flash crumbs to the shipyard in the Void Harbor.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.doop: Here it is. A little grease boat of your own. Give it a color, a sail and a name. Please don't break a bottle on it.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.geen_opdrac: A boat of your own? Then you need a commission. Take a look at the harbor board of a Mika Fortress.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.hint.briefj: Read the note on the harbor board at the pier of a Mika Fortress.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.hint.doop: Talk to the shipwright guh to christen your little grease boat.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.hint.materi: Gather 24 planks, 8 wool, 4 Mika's Grease and 2 flash crumbs.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.hint.werf: Bring the materials to the shipwright guh in the Void Harbor.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.materiaal: For a little grease boat I need: 24 planks, 8 wool, 4 Mika's Grease and 2 flash crumbs. Then I start right away!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.bootje.werf: Ah, my favorite skipper! Welcome to the yard. A new color? Another sail?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.element.aarde: Come back when you can earthbend, nyeg! Heh heh.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.element.lucht: Come back when you can airbend, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.element.vuur: Come back when you can firebend, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.element.water: Come back when you can waterbend, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.haven.veer.aan: The Chonky Wave drops you off at: %s
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.haven.veer.mist: The ferry can't get there: that place can't be found yet.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.haven.veer.verder: I can also take you here:
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.haven.veer.welkom: The Chonky Wave sails to every place you know. For free! Where do you want to go?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.afgeleid: WHAT?! A ship without a captain?! That can't be! That's NOT ALLOWED! I'm going to look! Nobody does anything until I'm back!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.afleiding.1: Look! A grease ship without a captain!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.afleiding.3: May I go through to the kitchen?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.dagsoep: Here, a bowl of Sorry Soup. Still warm. Sorry there's only one.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.haven: You came! Look, my own little kitchen. With a window! Onto the void! Here, the recipe for my Sorry Soup. Sorry it's so tasty.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.haven_vreemd: Hello? Do we know each other? Sorry. I'm new here. I'm sorry about all sorts of things.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.hint.haven: Visit the cook in his new kitchen in the Void Harbor: The Sorry Spatula.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.hint.ingredien: Gather the ingredients on the outer islands: blue cheese mushrooms, crystal cheese nuggets, nibble chorus fruits, a crumb cloud.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.hint.kapitein: Talk to the fortress captain on the ground floor and distract him.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.hint.terug: Go back to the cook in the fortress kitchen.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.ingredienten: I want to make real soup. With 2 blue cheese mushrooms, 2 crystal cheese nuggets, 2 nibble chorus fruits and 1 crumb cloud.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.ingredienten_k: Oh, this smells like the whole Guh End! But the captain mustn't see me cook. Could you... distract him?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.ingredienten_n: I don't have everything yet. Blue cheese mushrooms, crystal cheese nuggets, nibble chorus fruits, a crumb cloud. Sorry for asking so much.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.kapitein: WHAT DO YOU WANT? This is MY fortress. Say it quick, I'm busy with... things.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.kapitein_nog: The captain is downstairs. Think of something. Something he'll believe. Sorry.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.later.0: I have a window. I look at the void every day. Sorry, I'm just happy.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.later.1: The captain never found that ship. He's still looking. Sorry, captain.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.later.2: More soup tomorrow. Promise. Sorry it's only tomorrow.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.optie.ga: Go! I'll see you in the Void Harbor.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.optie.waarom: Why do you do it in secret?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.soep: He's gone! The soup is ready and the cells get a bowl. You know what? I'm leaving. I want a kitchen of my own. With a window.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.uitleg: Mikas aren't allowed to be nice. It says so in the Mika book, on page one. I tore out page one. Sorry.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.vertrek: Sorry for leaving so fast. Sorry for the mess. See you in the Void Harbor!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kok.welkom: Oh! Don't be scared. I'm only the cook. I secretly cook for the captured guhs. Every day. And I'm so sorry I'm a Mika.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.dank.0: A fan is no weapon. It's a little dance that happens to defend you too.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.dank.1: Kyoshi Guh always said: stand firm, and wear good shoes. Mostly the latter.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.dank.2: You're always welcome on the dance floor, warrior.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.dans: Stand on the golden tile in the middle of the dance floor. If I call DUCK, you crouch. JUMP, you jump. TURN, you turn around.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.dans_klaar: You dance like a real warrior! Come, to the makeup table. A warrior shows herself.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.dans_nog: The golden tile is waiting. Ten of the sixteen right and you're one of us.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.dans_opnieu: Not bad, but it has to be %s. Once more: stand on the golden tile again.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.dans_weg: You walked off the dance floor. Stand on the golden tile again to start over.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.fan: The fan guh at the gate has never seen a real warrior up close. Off you go. And keep a bucket handy.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.fan_later.0: Can I have your autograph? On my fan? On my face?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.fan_later.1: I only foamed once today. I'm getting stronger.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.fan_later.2: I have a poster of you. I drew it myself. Your ears came out a bit big.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.fan_schuim: A... a... A REAL KYOSHI WARRIOR! Here! With ME! *foam* *thud*
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.geschminkt_: White, red and a little gold
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.hint.dans: Stand on the golden tile in the middle of the dance floor in the dojo.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.hint.fan: Show yourself to the foaming fan guh by the gate.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.hint.schmin: Go to the makeup table under the mirror in the dojo.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.klaar: He fainted again. That's the fourth time this week. You belong with us now, warrior. Your makeup will suit your guh too.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.naam.leider: The Leader of the Kyoshi Warriors
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.schmink: The makeup table is under the mirror. White, red and a little gold.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.schmink_kla: You look like Kyoshi Guh herself! Go show yourself at the gate. There's someone there who... well. You'll see.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.uitleg: The Guhvatar with the biggest feet in the Guh End. She founded this village. Her statue still checks whether we practice well.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.kyoshi.welkom: A waterbender with the Kyoshi Warriors? We fight with fans, but first we dance. Dare to dance with us?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.dank.0: Listen. Can you hear the temple? It's humming.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.dank.1: The herd eats well again. Especially the smallest one. It eats for three.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.dank.2: An air nomad owns nothing except a good wind. And now yours too, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.fluit: Go to the balcony at the end of each wind corridor and use your air power there. Five corridors, five notes.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.fluit_klaar: Do you hear that?! The whole temple sings again! Now the herd can hear the way home. Help them a little more.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.hint.fluit: Use your air power on the balcony at the end of each wind corridor (5).
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.hint.kudde: Fly to the stray sky bison guhs around the island and click them, or aim your Air Ball at them from a distance (5).
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.hint.terug: Go back to the air nun guh in the hanging hall.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.klaar: It's been a long time since this temple sounded this cheerful. Here, two wind chimes. Hang them somewhere breezy.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.kudde_een: A sky bison guh flies home! (%s of %s)
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.kudde_klaar: They're all home! Five pens, five happy bison. Come, I have something for you.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.kudde_nog: %s sky bison guhs are still lost. They drift around the island.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.uitleg: Five wind corridors, each with a balcony at the end. Airbend there and the corridor whistles. Together they sing the herd home.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.lucht.welkom: Do you hear that? Nothing. The wind no longer whistles through the corridors, and our herd is lost. An airbender could help us.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.dank.0: Heh heh heh! Back for some crystal candy?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.dank.1: Flopsie likes you. I can tell by his tongue.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.dank.2: Who has the best chutes in the Guh End? ME!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.dank.3: I'm a hundred and twelve. Roughly. I count my birthdays with crystal candies and then I eat them. Heh heh.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.hint.proef1: Go to trial 1 (the waterfall of glass) below the throne room and use your earth power there.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.hint.proef2: Find Flopsie. Not in the hutch of trial 2, but somewhere... bigger.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.hint.proef3: Go to the arena of trial 3 and choose your opponent.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.hint.race: Slide from the loading platform in front of the palace to the post office within 40 seconds.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.kies: Trial three! Choose your opponent. Who dares you face?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.kies_fout.1: The Boulder Colossus? He's been asleep for a hundred years. Boring! Choose again.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.kies_fout.2: The Crystal Beast is a statue, nyeg. Choose again!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.kies_goed: ME?! HAHAHA! Well done! The most dangerous opponent always stands right beside you, laughing. I surrender!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.klaar: HAHAHA! Faster than the mail! Here, my Crystal Candy Ring. Give it a lick. Not all at once, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.lift: The mail lift sets you back on the loading platform. Jump into a chute and try again!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.naam_fout.1: Crystal Candy? Tasty, but no. Think simple!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.naam_fout.2: Flopsie is the pet! I'm the king. Again!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.naam_vraag: Last question. What... is... my... name?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.proef1: Trial one! A key hangs in the waterfall of glass. Get it out. Climb? Heh heh heh. Go ahead and try!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.proef1_klaar: YES! The key! ...It doesn't fit anything, by the way. HAHAHA! I wanted to see how you think. Trial two!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.proef1_nog: The key is still in the waterfall! Climbing doesn't work, does it? What can an earthbender do that a climber can't?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.proef2_klaar: You found Flopsie! That hutch wasn't for him, it was for his teddy. Trial three!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.proef2_nog: Find Flopsie! My little pet. Small. Sweet. More or less. Heh heh.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.proef3_klaar: Bumi Guh! Always been my name! One more thing: the mail chute. Race the mail!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.proef3_nog: Trial three waits in the arena. Choose your opponent. Choose wisely. Or madly. Same thing, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.proef_sub.1: The key falls out of the waterfall
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.race: Jump into a chute on the loading platform. Reach the post office within forty counts and you're faster than the mail!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.race_klaar: Jump into a mail chute! The clock starts as soon as you slide.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.race_kwijt: You fell off the chute. Never mind: the mail lift takes you back up in a moment.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.race_te_laat: Heh heh, %s! The mail was faster. Once more: the mail lift takes you up in a moment!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.uitleg: To learn to think like a mad old king! Don't look at what something seems. Look at what it is. *snort-giggle*
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.welkom: Heh heh! A Guhvatar! With ME! You know what you need? Trials! Three of them. And they work differently than you think, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.zone.1: A key, high up in a waterfall of glass. Climbing never works... but the ground beneath you might listen.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.omash.zone.2: A teeny tiny hutch with giant paw prints in front of it. Flopsie doesn't live here. Or is Flopsie very big?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.mis: Out of the race! The wind sets you back on the start platform in a moment; then talk to the race master guh to start again.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.niet_op_start: Stand on the starting platform first.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.terug: Back on the start platform. Talk to the race master guh for a new round!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.titel: Under %s! You are a true Ring Racer!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.uitleg: Fly through all eighteen rings, in order, and land on the landing strip. Under %s and you earn a title!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.welkom: Welcome to the Guh Wing Ring Race! Eighteen rings, one landing strip, and the clock is running. Ready?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.race.welkom_terug: There's my racer! Your best time is %s. Can you go faster?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.dagwijsh: Whoever hurries misses the view. Whoever doesn't hurry sometimes misses the boat. Both are fine.
An island that swims is never lost. It is simply on its way.
The void seems empty. But sometimes something sings in it. Just listen.
You don't have to be able to do everything. You only have to know who can.
Sharing a nibble is eating twice. Once with your mouth, once with your heart.
Even an old turtle still learns something. Today I learned that you came to visit me.
Water flows around the stone. The stone is fine with that.
Sleep well, eat well, chonk well. The rest follows by itself.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.gevangen: The Lion Turtle Guh catches you!
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.hint.kna: Hold a cheese nibble and click the snout of the Lion Turtle, on his palm.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.hint.poo: Walk to the raised paw of the Lion Turtle and stand on his palm.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.kietel: Hmmmmm? Who is tickling my shell? Come on down, little one. To my paw.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.klaar: Wear that scale well. It knows where I am, and I know where you are.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.kom_op_p: Come stand on my paw, little one. My eyes aren't what they used to be.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.morgen: One wisdom a day, little one. More is too heavy for a small tummy.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.offer: Do you know what I haven't had for ages? A nibble. Put one in my paw.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.offer_no: A nibble, little one. Hold it and give it to my snout.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.slaap: *Zzzzzz... a deep, warm snore, as big as an island.*
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.vraag: Tell me, little one. What are you actually looking for?
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wakker.1: Ah. A Guhvatar. I have seen quite a few. They come, they go. I swim.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wakker.2: I am older than the islands, and almost as chonky. That's a compliment, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wijs.1: Strength. Hm. Whoever is strong can carry. Whoever is wise knows when to put something down.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wijs.2: Rest. Good answer. Rest is not standing still. Rest is swimming without hurry.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.schildpad.wijs.3: HOHOHO. At last someone who tells the truth. Nibbles are strength and rest at once.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.deuren: Upstairs, stand before each fire door and use your fire power. Five locks, five flames. And be quiet, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.deuren_open: They're open! All five! Go inside, Guhvatar. I'll keep the others busy with tea.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.hint.deuren: Use your fire power before each of the five fire doors at the top of the tower.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.hint.heiligdo: Walk through one of the open fire doors into the sanctum.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.hint.roku: Talk to Roku Guh in the sanctum.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.open: The doors are open, for you. Go into the sanctum.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku.1: Long ago I had a friend. He was the prince of fire, and I was the Guhvatar. We shared everything. Our nibbles too.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku.2: When he became Fire Lord, he wanted more. More land. More nibbles. I said no, and he did not hear me.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku.3: I should have stopped him sooner. Not with fire, but with friendship. I waited too long.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku.4: His grandson is Fire Lord Mikai. The hunger stayed the same. But you have something I did not have back then.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku.5: You have friends who dare to tell you the truth. Listen to them. That is the whole secret, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku_klaar: Take this little flame with you. It never goes out, like a good friendship. I'll see you again, Guhvatar.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku_later.0: A flame you share does not grow smaller.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku_later.1: Kyoshi Guh says I talk too much. Kyoshi Guh talks with her feet.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku_later.2: Go on. The world is waiting. I'll wait here, I'm good at that.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.roku_wacht: He's really there? Roku Guh? Go, go! Don't keep him waiting.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.shyu_dank.0: My grandpa would be so proud. And a little jealous.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.shyu_dank.1: The other Fire Sages think there was a draft in the tower. I'm not saying anything.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.shyu_dank.2: Fire is like tea: too hot and you burn yourself, too cold and it does you no good.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.uitleg: The sanctum, with the statue of Roku Guh. My grandpa was the last to see him there. I believe he is still waiting.
quest.guhs.einde2_zij.vuur.welkom: Shh. The other Fire Sages mustn't hear. The five doors upstairs only open for the fire of a Guhvatar.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_einde_gedicht.cred: With the guhs of the Guhmension, the Barbecuether and the Guh End
With the Mikas (who only ever push)
With Team Guhvatar, still waiting for you
With every guh that was ever petted
And with you. Thanks for playing, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_einde_gedicht.rege: That a nibble you share is worth two nibbles.
That you don't own a guh. A guh chooses you.
And that the Guh End is no end. Just a place with a nice name.
There's more to come. There's always more to come.
Shh. The player is waking up.
Wake up, player. A cheese ball is waiting for you.
...and the player went for a chonk.
A player? With nibbles in every pocket?
That one. That one just beat the Overlord Mika.
Beat? Or pushed back very hard?
In the Guh End that's the same thing.
Does the player know we are watching?
Sometimes. When it's quiet. When the guhs are asleep and the campfire crackles.
What shall we tell the player?
That the world is bigger than the edge of the screen.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_einde_gedicht.tite: The Poem of the Guh End
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_bieb_planetar: Turn the wheel next to Professor Zei Guh.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_bieb_vos.teks: He has a book for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_haven_kok.tek: His own little kitchen, on the quay.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_haven_werf.te: The shipwright guh is waiting by the slipway.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_kyoshi_dans.t: Stand here, and follow the calls on the beat.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_kyoshi_fan.te: He has been waiting for years for a real warrior.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_kyoshi_schmin: Under the mirror in the dojo.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_lucht_kudde.t: Click it, or blow at it with Air Ball.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_lucht_windflu: Stand on the balcony and let the wind sing.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_omash_glijbaa: Step into a mail chute and slide down!
Go in and use your earth power.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_schildpad_kop: A cheese nibble in your hand, and click.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_schildpad_top: The highest point of his shell.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_vuur_deuren.t: Stand before a door and use your fire power.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_kijk_vuur_heiligdo: The doors are open. Just for you.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_knipoog_mew.regels: Rule one: no Mikas. Rule two: no fire. Rule three: everything stays neatly on its shelf.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_knipoog_mew.titel: Wink: Mew Guh in the Library
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_leeuwschildpad_zeg: A nibble. Just given away. Do you know how rare that is, little one?
I won't give you power. You have enough power, with your elements and your friends.
I give you something else. A place to fall back on.
Should you ever fall into the void, an old turtle will catch you. The void is not that big, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_opper_mika_opkomst: Every nibble here is MINE. Every crystal. Every crumb!
I'll push every one of you back where you came from!
THE OVERLORD MIKA - ruler of the Guh End
WHO dares to stand on MY Nibble Mountain?!
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_roku_zonnestraal.h: I have been waiting for you, young Guhvatar. A long time. I have become rather patient.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_roku_zonnestraal.o: The eyes of the statue begin to glow.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_roku_zonnestraal.p: Come closer. I want to tell you about friendship, and about a friend who always wanted more.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_roku_zonnestraal.w: I am Roku Guh. Before Aang Guh, I was the Guhvatar. So in a way, I was you. Confusing, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_zij_roku_zonnestraal.z: Once a day the sun shines straight through the window of the sanctum.
